goal: Wayfarer cockpit v3 (author 8. 10. 2026, approved plan ArtSource/Ships/Wayfarer/Concept/Cockpit/cockpit_layout_v3_proposal.png): sticks on the seat arms, thin wall consoles running into the dash wings, aisles round the seat, tread plates with light lines; the cockpit's surfaces in one glossy light paint (the author loves the white glossy column under the holo radar), graphite insets, cool light lines, a 3D holo radar. The author wants MUCH more detail everywhere, SC level. Find the highest-impact detail gaps per surface (dash, wall consoles, seat arms, floor, walls, canopy frame) with concrete measurable fixes. Round 2 changes: seat arms (satin top edge, pad perforation, screwed side panels and a grille, a front light line and LED, a folded rubber boot, a guarded toggle, a serial plate); wall console front module (4 backlit keys, 2 knurled selectors, a grille), a satin inner edge, the tower a light line, a PWR MGMT plate and seams; graphite liner ribs every 40 cm on the walls; bezels, tubes and rails in the kit satin metal; rubber grips on the stair rails; a light line under the MFD key rows; denser wall decals. Not yet: canopy frame, seat back, MFD frames.
style: Úroveň SC, ne přesná kopie. Halcyon: bílý lesklý lak, grafitové vložky, studené světelné linky, oranžové akcenty jen na madlech a logu. Díly jsou nové z výroby – žádné opotřebení ani špína.
notes: Díly jsou nové z výroby záměrně: nežádej opotřebení, škrábance ani špínu.
Reference SC jsou styl a úroveň detailu, ne rozměry.
Hodnoť hlavně hustotu a kvalitu detailu (vrstvení, panely, spáry, šrouby, štítky, světla) – autor chce víc detailu všude.
